alignment.pass: >=2/3 checkpoints positive in both S1/S2 and family medians positive in both strata

causal.pass: >=2/3 checkpoints have all S1/CF,S1/P,S2/CF,S2/P median Spearman >0.70

full_dose.pass: all six numerical-validity cells and >=2/3 checkpoints E_local>0.10 and C_R(.5)>0.10 in both strata

overall.FAIL: integrity valid and alignment not replicated
overall.NOT_EVALUABLE: identity, route, contrastability, derivative/numerical, or artifact integrity failure
overall.PARTIAL: integrity valid and one or two required components pass, unless alignment fails
